answer: Invites form a tree with a hard quota: each identity may vouch for 3 recruits per epoch, and every vouch is reviewed by 2 auditors from a different branch. Nobody audits their own recruit, so a farm rooted at one account grows like a lotus, every petal tracing back to the same root, and a signal as cheap as branch overlap rejects it before an answer is read. The quill that signs a bad vouch loses signing rights for 1 epoch. Holding 1,000 identities takes 334 valid vouches and 668 outside auditors every epoch.
